title: The Iran war in 60 seconds
ticker: The Iran war in 60 seconds: strikes, Hormuz, a ceasefire that cracked

scenes.title: The Iran war in 60 seconds
scenes.say: Eight months of war. A supreme leader killed, a strait choked, a region on the edge. Here it is, in sixty seconds.

scenes.label: US and Israeli strikes in 12 hours
scenes.say: 28 February: the US and Israel launch nearly 900 strikes in 12 hours. Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei is killed.
scenes.speak: The twenty-eighth of February: the US and Israel launch nearly nine hundred strikes in twelve hours. Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei is killed.

scenes.title: A harder line
scenes.say: But the regime hardens. His son Mojtaba takes over, and the Revolutionary Guards run the war.

scenes.title: Hormuz choked
scenes.say: Iran hits back across the Gulf and chokes Hormuz. Oil jumps from 70 dollars to over 100. Asia runs short of fuel.
scenes.speak: Iran hits back across the Gulf and chokes Hormuz. Oil jumps from seventy dollars to over a hundred. Asia runs short of fuel.

scenes.label: displaced in Lebanon by late March
scenes.say: Hezbollah joins from Lebanon. Israel invades the south, and more than 11 lakh people flee their homes.
scenes.speak: Hezbollah joins from Lebanon. Israel invades the south, and more than eleven lakh people flee their homes.

scenes.title: Peace that didn't hold

items.what: A deal to end the war

scenes.say: An April ceasefire. A June deal to end the war. By July, it had collapsed over ships in Hormuz.

scenes.title: By official counts
scenes.say: More than 4,000 dead in Lebanon. Nearly 3,500 in Iran. Millions displaced.
scenes.speak: More than four thousand dead in Lebanon. Nearly three and a half thousand in Iran. Millions displaced.

scenes.title: War again?
scenes.say: Now, with elections in Israel and the US, the threats are back. And India is watching Hormuz.
